rna.text: Kaya came to Ravnica as an assassin, hired by Bolas to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster, and Bolas promised to heal Tolvada's sky in return for her help.
Along the way she left Emilio Revari to his mother's ghost after learning he had murdered her, and she assassinated the ghostly King Brago.
She then ended the Obzedat's meeting, killed the Ghost Council and took the guildmaster's seat through a loophole, which left Orzhov vampires looking for allies in case she turned on them.

Once in charge, Kaya freed many people from their debts, so Teysa ended their partnership; at the guild summit she saw the guilds dissolve after Isperia's murder, then turned the tables, had Teysa arrested and offered the hierarchs a deal.

war.text: When Bolas's Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica, Kaya saw his treachery and defected from him for good, and she joined the Gatewatch to atone.
She gathered Rat and Teyo, fought the Eternals beside Ral Zarek, and told Rat that Hekara was dead.
Then she went to win allies: the Orzhov Triumvirate at first offered only an honor guard, until Bilagru offered the Syndicate's enforcers and Kaya threatened to forgive every debt.
Selesnya joined after Harmony woke, Vraska returned to unite the Golgari, and Hekara was resurrected, even as Teysa took advantage of Kaya's absence to seize the Syndicate's leadership.

mh1.text: Kaya appears among this set's cards as a planeswalker who speaks of hierarchy.

khm.text: On Kaldheim, Kaya traveled with Inga's party and helped them fight a monster that killed Omenseekers; Inga froze its arm and Kaya severed it with her dagger.
Alrund revealed himself, shielded the party and promised Kaya the longship of Cosima, and he later stepped in again when she and the Omenseekers fought Vorinclex in Aldergard.
Kaya also met the planeswalker Tyvar Kell, who had turned Tibalt's trolls to stone, and the two of them failed to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar.
To end it, she carried the Sword of the Realms to Halvar with help from Arni, Cosima and Harald, then killed Varragoth by cutting his throat while Halvar sealed the Doomskar.

bro.text: Kaya helped Saheeli and Teferi build and run the Temporal Anchor in Urza's tower, so that Teferi's spirit could travel back in time.
When a lingering spirit sabotaged the anchor, she pursued the ghost of General Sharaman and killed him in her ghostform, then knelt shaken.
She also briefed the group on the plan to destroy the Phyrexian World Tree with the sylex, but she could not pull Teferi's spirit back before the anchor failed and he was set adrift in time.

one.text: Kaya joined the strike team to infiltrate New Phyrexia and destroy Realmbreaker, fighting alongside Elspeth and reuniting with Tyvar and Jace.
At the Seedcore, Jace insisted on detonating the sylex, though Kaya warned the blast could reach every connected plane, and she and Kaito tried to stop him.
What she grabbed turned out to be an illusion that dissolved like mist, and when Elesh Norn invited the survivors to join Phyrexia as the invasion began, Kaya refused.

mom.text: Elesh Norn held Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar captive, had Nahiri encase them in stone, and then let them escape on purpose so they could spread her gospel.
Back with the other planeswalkers, Kaya reported that Phyrexia was using the World Tree to invade, and she forbade Chandra from returning, warning she would be compleated.
She then went with Kaito to defend Kamigawa, where she phased through a wall to rescue a trapped boy and his dog, and later she killed the compleated Heliod on Theros.
While she defended the Multiverse, Teysa Karlov took her place as Orzhov guildmaster.

mkm.text: Back on Ravnica, Kaya was pressed by Teysa, who reminded her she owed the Orzhov for missing the invasion, and she nearly planeswalked away before a scream from the manor sent her running toward it.
She refused Ezrim's offer to lead the investigation of Zegana's murder, but then found Teysa dead in her parlor, with a note in Phyrexian script that she pocketed.
Kaya returned to Ezrim, told him Teysa had been murdered, and was given leadership of the investigation.

Reading the Guildpact in Vitu-Ghazi, she connected Etrata's missing memory to Rakdos's influence, and later she trapped the rampaging Anzrag in a capsule before confessing the Phyrexian note to Proft.

clu.text: On this set's cards, Kaya is an Orzhov guildmaster whose power and hatred of the living dead are noted, and she warns of the gilded lie.
